title: behaviorFacts
responsibility: Formats duration and ordered scenario outcomes for Reports and Desktop.

inputs.name: behaviorFacts.duration
inputs.description: This text supplies the duration row; null is rendered as “Not measured,” while a non-null string is preserved verbatim. Highlighting marks only the literal input string “Not measured” as unmeasured, not null.

inputs.name: behaviorFacts.scenarios
inputs.description: These ordered scenario records become facts after the duration row, one per indexed entry. The helper reads length and numeric indices, so array iterator and species behavior do not affect traversal.

inputs.name: behaviorFacts.paired
inputs.description: This flag controls whether each scenario value includes its before outcome and an arrow. When true, a missing before or after outcome is shown as “not run”; when false, the before outcome is omitted.

inputs.name: behaviorFacts.options
inputs.description: These optional settings control the duration label and status highlighting. A missing durationLabel uses “E2E duration,” and a missing highlight behaves as false; highlighting marks the literal “Not measured” duration text and scenario outcomes other than “passed”.

outputs.name: behaviorFacts
outputs.description: The helper returns one duration fact followed by one fact per scenario, preserving scenario order. It creates a new array and uses the configured label, paired outcome prefix, and highlighting rules.

errors.name: Input access error
errors.description: Exceptions thrown while reading supplied option or scenario properties, array length or indexed entries, or coercing an outcome value propagate to the caller; the helper does not catch or normalize them.
